messages:
Anya: Quick ping — opened PR #8421 that changes the onprem connector auth flow. Touches KMS usage, secret mounting, and adds an explicit VPC egress rule for telemetry. Need security + infra eyes before we merge.
Sam: Thanks Anya. Can you paste the diff for the VPC rule? want to confirm CIDR and ports.
Anya: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/9a3b — new rule allows outbound 10.20.0.0/16:443 to telemetry.example.com and 10.20.1.0/24:10250 for kube-probes. Also adds toggle `ONPREM_TELEMETRY_EGRESS=true`.
Lee: tagging infra — @Sam are those host ranges okay for our onprem customers? any concerns about leaking internal subnets?
Sam: From infra side looks fine but need to double-check NAT/BGP overlap with some partner DCs. I'll run a quick overlap check.
SecurityBot: secret-scan: 1 finding — flagged usage of `REDWOOD_ONPREM_KEY` env var without rotation metadata. Severity: low. Suggest add `rotation_window_days`.
Maria: Re: secret-scan — the PR adds code path that reads KMS key alias `alias/onprem-ingest`. We should ensure HSM fallback is covered in the code path and add unit tests for key-fetch errors.
Anya: Good catch. I added a TODO and created test stub in the PR (see file tests/auth/test_kms_failover.py). CI shows one flaky test unrelated to PR: `test_healthcheck_delay`.
Lee: For approvals: assign security and infra. I can do security review if Anya adds the rotation metadata + test for key fetch failure. Sam to confirm VPC CIDR ok.
Sam: Running overlap check now — should have answer in ~30m. If no overlap, infra can approve with a follow-up to log the egress events for 2 weeks.
Anya: I've pushed a small change: added `rotation_window_days: 7` to secret bootstrap and a unit test that mocks KMS timeout. PTAL.
Maria: quick nit: update the PR description to call out the maintenance window you want to merge in. ops prefers merges during the weekend 02:00-06:00 UTC for onprem rolls.
Anya: Noted — I'll update description and request the weekend slot.
DeployBot: deploy-check: PR #8421 — required checks: CI ✅ (except flaky test), secrets-scan ✅, infra-approval ⏳, security-approval ⏳.
Sam: overlap check done — no CIDR conflicts detected. infra comfortable with the ranges. Will add approval once logs-on-merge is added (simple rsyslog rule in the docs).
Lee: Security reviewed the auth changes. small request to include rotation schedule in docs and add an audit log line when fallback to HSM occurs.
Anya: Updated docs & added audit log entry in `auth/audit.py` before HSM fallback. Pushed.
Maria: LGTM from SE side, but hold merge until we trigger canary on one onprem customer and monitor for 24h.
Anya: Copy. I'll request canary + schedule merge for Sunday 03:00 UTC, will post results here.
Sam: approving from infra. @Lee you can approve security if you are happy.
Lee: Approved. :white_check_mark:
Anya: Thanks all — merging after canary confirms. Will post status in this thread. :thumbsup:
